title: Avesta's island continent that froze over

tellings.quote: So in the Avesta it says that the the you know Arian the Aryan people uh come from an island continent at the center of the world which froze over

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast American Alchemy, a researcher named Jason Jorjani says the Avesta, the ancient holy scriptures of Iran's Zoroastrian religion, tells that the Aryan people came from "an island continent at the center of the world which froze over." Jorjani gives this as his own summary of the text without pointing to a passage, and the story ties that frozen homeland to Antarctica. If it were true, it would mean an old Iranian memory of a lost frozen land in the far south.
